'''Lancer4life Maul Deck''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Lancer4life]]
* '''Published:''' 4 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Tatooine: Desert Landing Site|Tat-D-tatooinedesertlandingsite.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tatooine: Desert Landing Site
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed DLS Lancer4life DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This is a Modified version of Patrick Napiers "Marilyn Maul" deck

== Strategy ==

This deck uses Gallid drains, while it has descent destiny, can protect against HB and Lightsaber combat,  Few touches added in that i like.
